author: Codex
requested_mechanism: Start from frozen best006328.4468us. Isolate one source-level mechanism: for BF16 noncausal SINGLE_KV only, allocate a contiguous FP16 V scratch and convert original V once using a new pure Triton preprocessing kernel. Feed this scratch and its actual strides to unchanged attention arithmetic, preserving PV_SINGLE_F16 derived from original V dtype. Keep main kernel name _gqa_fwd_kernel, M128/N256, original Q/K BF16 QK, FP32 softmax, FP16 PV and all output expressions. Keep all other paths exactly original. No other tiling, precision, grouping or compiler-option changes. Host limited to allocation/metadata/launch; no torch data conversion, caches or backends. Full-call benchmark includes the scratch allocation and extra launch. Source-bound post profiling/simulator will separately capture all compiled binaries and replay attention from true device-produced inputs if needed. Preprocessing kernel needs masks/strides appropriate for actual original V, unique output ownership and no uninitialized values consumed.
analysis: 本轮模拟器输入绑定当前保留006。006模拟器把V载入定位到softmax之后，PV侧Cube WAIT_FLAG_DEVI9.59μs，Vector的V载入1.66μs、PV相关WAIT1.66μs和BAR2.34μs，各时段重叠，独立保留。009提前V组织得到四项合格负结果357.02675μs，真实重放显示QK前增加4.82μs相关等待，后段8.13μs；010沿009放大M256/N256，UB从008230912B降至198656B，仍超196608B，且CC262144B超131072B，其他三项通过，当前最佳保持006。源码与实际IR支持一个具体缺口：BF16 V转FP16在每个query-head/query-tile重复执行并经Vector准备交给Cube；目标实际V仅4×256×8×128×2=2MiB，当前512program按共享KV重复转换/交接。先用独立Triton kernel集中转换，每个V元素转换一次，主attention直接读FP16 V进入PV，期望删除该路径Vector BF16载入/转换和相关同步，代价为2MiB额外写读、分配及一次launch。主kernel QK、softmax、PV数值表达及M/N保持；中间V位型与006转换后保持。原合同[-1,1]适用域沿用，官方四项checker决定正确性，完整调用计时包含全部阶段。该改法由模拟器指定V准备链与负实验支持，profiling同时提供每program流量和等待，工具独立增量尚待分离。后端是否改为GM到L1直接V读取、是否仍产生Vector搬运需查实际IR与后重放；若额外启动成本吞掉收益仍完整保存。Triton已能表达该组织，当前先改源码。
